name: indigitalstudio-marketplace
description: Indigital Studio marketplace for omp skills, plugins, and extensions.

plugins.name: sample-skill
plugins.description: A sample skill demonstrating the marketplace plugin structure. Greets the user with a friendly message.

plugins.name: project-loader
plugins.description: Global bootstrap that loads project-local .js extensions from <cwd>/.omp/extensions/ on session start.

plugins.name: git-sync
plugins.description: Session-start git pull --rebase with stash preservation. Auto-syncs the repo when an omp session begins.

plugins.name: path-guard
plugins.description: Global extension enforcing path-access-control rules. Auto-creates rules/path-access-control.md template on session start if missing. Blocks writes outside allowed paths.

plugins.name: workflows
plugins.description: Atomic workflow engine for omp — multi-stage agent orchestration with durable checkpointing, graph-based workflow execution, and reactive TUI widgets.

plugins.name: sidebar-stats
plugins.description: Responsive status rail and activity sidebar — adapted from Pi Atelier by michaelmjhhhh. Live agent, tool, context, workspace, usage, and TODO telemetry.
